description: Rescue an orphaned manual block: splice its prose back into a @manual zone under a target anchor (defaulting to the suggested present-again / renamed anchor) and remove the archive, or delete the orphan. The non-interactive counterpart of `ovellum orphans --reattach`.

anchorId.description: The orphan to act on (its original anchor id).

delete.description: Delete the orphan instead of reattaching.

target.description: Anchor id to reattach under (default: the suggested target).

name: ovellum_reattach
